title: Cosmic Wanderer on Stone
description: A lone figure in a dark hooded cloak sits atop a massive boulder in a barren desert landscape, gazing upward. The night sky swirls with glowing planets, comets, and intricate constellations connected by luminous lines that wrap around the stone.
prompt: A hooded figure in a dark blue cloak sits on a giant boulder in a desolate desert at twilight, looking up at a swirling cosmic sky filled with multiple colorful planets, glowing comets, and intricate glowing constellation lines that wrap around the stone surface, dramatic lighting, painted in a detailed fantasy style
